items.title: Benjie White Interview, 1961-03-16
items.q: I think Brunus had been playing in there before we were

ctx.x: Was it near the Markham Hotel, in that area?

It was the Markham Hotel, we opened that up, the new Markham Hotel, in our barnstorming days, uh, when we were playing with the Strand Theater, this is quite an incident, uh, we, uh, had a tour during the summertime, went all up through the country, up into North Louisiana, Mississippi, even up to Arkansas, uh, playing, playing, one night stands, in various theaters, and we got to a place, called, uh, let's see, it was up here in Arkansas, uh, well anyway, we played a theater there, and we were supposed, supposed…
What did he do on that record, did he play banjo, or guitar?
